title: One Day Their Voice Will Be A Memory
hook: ONE DAY, THEIR VOICE WILL BE A MEMORY

steps.hook: One day, an old voicemail will be the only way to hear your parents' voice.
steps.curiosity: Most people realize this too late.
steps.build: The calls you skip because you're busy. The stories you've heard a hundred times. The 'did you eat?' that annoys you now... One day, you'd give anything to hear it again.
steps.payoff: So call them today. Not tomorrow. Today. Because 'later' is a promise time doesn't keep.
